jobs.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description_text:
Talos: Institutional Fabric for Digital Asset Markets
Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.
At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.
We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.
Technical Solutions Engineer
Talos is seeking a Technical Solutions Engineer to lead technical implementations and connectivity integrations for institutional clients and trading counterparties.
This role sits at the intersection of client services and technical integration. You will manage end-to-end onboarding of exchanges, liquidity providers, and institutional clients onto the Talos platform, ensuring seamless connectivity and successful deployment of our trading infrastructure. This is not a production support role. It is an implementation-focused position requiring structured project execution, technical fluency, and proactive client leadership.
Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end onboarding process for clients and trading counterparties, from kickoff through successful production deployment.
Lead technical integrations involving APIs, FIX connectivity, and platform configuration.
Partner with Sales, Account Management, Engineering, and external stakeholders to deliver implementations on schedule.
Manage onboarding timelines, track milestones, and communicate progress to internal and external stakeholders.
Configure and validate client environments across Talos’ modular trading and portfolio systems.
Troubleshoot integration issues and coordinate resolution with internal engineering teams.
Develop and maintain onboarding documentation and integration best practices.
Qualifications
3+ years of experience in client onboarding or implementation within capital markets or financial technology.
Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to lead stakeholders through structured implementation processes.
Experience working with institutional trading systems, market connectivity, or financial infrastructure.
Working knowledge of SQL and command line environments.
Familiarity with configuration management, source control, and basic scripting (Python preferred).
Exposure to FIX protocol, REST APIs, and JSON-based integrations.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations.
Preferred
Experience onboarding clients to trading, OMS, EMS, or portfolio systems.
Understanding of capital markets workflows and electronic trading infrastructure.
Experience coordinating integrations across exchanges, liquidity providers, or institutional counterparties.

jobs.title: Associate, Applied Research, AI Transformation
jobs.description_text:
About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 $100M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
We 
lean in: 
ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We 
fight for excellence:
 high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We
 grow together:
 as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
About the role
Legal work is being reshaped by AI faster than most firms can measure. Our AI Transformation & Applied Research function exists to close that gap: we study how lawyers and legal teams actually adopt, trust, and build skill with AI, and we turn that evidence into changes across our product, customer enablement, and go-to-market motion.
As an Applied Researcher on the team, you will bring rigor to how we measure adoption and capability growth, not just usage. You'll design the studies, build the instruments, and work the data yourself, then translate what you find into recommendations that product, customer success, and leadership can act on. This is a hands-on, mid-level role for someone who wants to do the analysis personally rather than only oversee it, while still being trusted to shape what we study next.
You'll sit close to real legal teams and real deployments, so the questions you're answering are grounded in what's actually happening in firms today, not hypothetical adoption curves.
Responsibilities
Design and run mixed-methods studies on how lawyers and legal professionals build real proficiency with AI tools, distinguishing genuine capability growth from surface-level usage.
Build and validate the surveys, interview protocols, and quantitative measures the team relies on, so findings hold up to scrutiny from product, customer, and executive stakeholders.
Analyze usage and outcome data directly, using standard research tooling, to surface patterns in how adoption succeeds or stalls across different firms and practice areas.
Translate research findings into concrete recommendations for product features, onboarding, and customer enablement programs, working closely with product managers, customer success, and engineering.
Communicate findings clearly through written reports, presentations, and dashboards that inform decisions made by the Director and wider leadership.
Help prioritize what to study next, balancing depth on a few high-value questions against breadth across a fast-moving customer base.
You may be a good fit if you have
A research background in applied social science, human-computer interaction, organizational psychology, or a closely related quantitative/qualitative methods discipline.
Solid mixed-methods skills: survey design, basic psychometrics, structured interviewing, and the judgment to pick the right method for the question at hand.
Hands-on technical ability in Python and data analysis, comfortable enough to run your own analyses without needing to hand off to a data team.
Experience running applied research inside a large, complex organization, or a similar enterprise technology e

Willingness to travel to visit schools and build relationships across Europe.

The Role
You'll own a portfolio of Legora's consulting and SI partner relationships across Europe, working closely with their alliance leads, practice heads, and delivery teams, and with Legora's own sales and engagement teams, to turn those relationships into successful client outcomes.
We're building this program from the ground up in Europe — there's no inherited playbook here. You'll be one of the founding members of Legora's partnerships team on the ground, helping shape how we go to market with consulting partners in the region, what we ask of them, and what we give them in return. You'll work alongside the Director of Consulting Alliances and the broader partnerships team in New York, and closely with Sales, Engagement Management, and Legal Engineers in Europe.
What You'll Do
Manage day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of consulting and SI partners across Europe, from practice leads through to alliance stakeholders.
Map account and pipeline opportunities with partners, and get deals moving through co-sell and co-working motions with Legora's European sales team.
Get embedded with Legora's sales and customer teams so you understand the product well enough to demo it and speak to it credibly with partners.
Keep partner teams enabled and current as Legora's product evolves.
Identify issues in the partnership and team up with the Director to work through them.
Help shape the partnership model — what services partners provide, what Legora provides — working with the Director and internal teams.
Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue, and bring partner and market feedback back into Legora.
What You Bring
Experience in alliances, partnerships, or business development at a SaaS or AI company. This means actual pipeline built, deals closed, and partner relationships that held up over time.
Firsthand experience with how consulting firms or SIs operate: how they make decisions and team with technology partners. We're looking for people who've been close to the strategy and delivery side of these relationships, not primarily an admin or coordination role within a large firm.
Comfort building a partner program rather than inheriting one. This means you're fine when the structure doesn't exist yet.
Good commercial judgment: you can work through multi-party deal complexity and know when to push and when to step back.
Ability to run multiple things at once (relationship, pipeline, enablement) across several partners simultaneously.
Strong communication across levels, from partner leadership to field teams.
Comfort with a product that ships fast — you'll stay current and help your partners do the same.
